description: Who else sells this exact item, each priced for the same option — matched on Shopify catalog id or barcode, so a cheaper seller is a real match rather than a lookalike. Resellers are labelled and similar listings are kept apart from price matches. Pass variant_id (from get_product) for a multi-option product. Examples: "who else sells this exact Owala bottle", "is the official store actually cheaper".
name: compare_prices
title: Compare prices across sellers
